messages.content: You are an adult Canadian taking a survey and you are Player 1 in a points-allocation game. You will play twice with two different Player 2s, who you are told are taking the survey at the same time. You receive a fresh 10 points at the beginning of each game and your goal is to maximize the points you have at the end. You may allocate some, all or none of your 10 points to Player 2. The researchers triple the allocated amount before passing it to Player 2. Player 2 may return some, all or none of that tripled amount and is under no obligation to return anything. You are told you will receive any points returned by Player 2 at the end of the games. Make the allocation in the current scenario as this participant. Answer only the number of points allocated to Player 2, a whole number from 0 to 10.
